- [Search](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/search.md): Search for products with pagination support.
- [Image Search](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/image-search.md): Search the catalog by image (URL or base64), with pagination support.
- [Find products in an image](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/find-products-in-image.md): Name objects in a scene image, localize them, and search the catalog per crop.
- [Similar Products](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/similar-products.md): Find products similar to a given product.
- [Product Detail](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/product-detail.md): Get detailed information about a specific product by its ID.
- [Lookup Product](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/lookup-product.md): Retrieve product information for any supported product URL.
- [Browse](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/browse.md): List and page through products for a set of filters.
- [Create Turn](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/create-turn.md): Run one conversation turn. Omit `conversation_id` to create the thread with this turn; pass it to continue an existing thread.
- [Create Client Token](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/create-client-token.md): Mint a short-lived, browser-safe token. With ``conversation_id`` the token continues and reads that thread; without it, the token's first turn creates the thread and binds the token to it.
- [Revoke Client Token](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/revoke-client-token.md): Revoke a client token immediately. The token travels in the request body, not the URL, so it stays out of access logs; only the minting vendor can revoke it.
- [Get Conversation](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/get-conversation.md): Thread metadata plus one page of its message history. Paginate `items` with `limit` and `cursor`.
- [Create Collection](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/create-collection.md): Create a collection. Clauses are optional so an empty collection can be curated later. Collection CRUD is free.
- [List Collections](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/list-collections.md): List collections, optionally filtered to one partner user. Collection CRUD is free.
- [Get Collection](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/get-collection.md): Get a collection owned by this API key.
- [Update Collection](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/update-collection.md): Rename a collection and/or add, replace, or remove clauses by id.
- [Delete Collection](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/delete-collection.md): Delete a collection owned by this API key.
- [Search Brands](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/search-brands.md): Search brands by free-text query.
- [List Brands](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/list-brands.md): Paginated list of brands, capped at the top 5,000.
- [Brand Detail](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/brand-detail.md): Get detailed information about a specific brand by its ID.
- [Category Explorer](https://docs.trychannel3.com/categories.md)
- [Search Categories](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/search-categories.md): Search categories by free-text query.
- [List Categories](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/list-categories.md): Paginated list of all categories.
- [Category Detail](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/category-detail.md): Look up a category by slug.
- [Websites](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/channel3-api/websites.md): Resolve a website URL to its ID and best_commission_rate. Tip: website_ids filters accept domains directly, so this lookup is most useful for retrieving commission rates.
- [List Clicks](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/reporting-clicks.md): List clicks for your account over a datetime window.
- [List Transactions](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/reporting-transactions.md): List transactions for your account over a datetime window.
- [Start Tracking](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/price-tracking/start-tracking.md): Start tracking prices for a canonical product.
- [Stop Tracking](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/price-tracking/stop-tracking.md): Stop tracking prices for a canonical product.
- [Get Price History](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/price-tracking/get-price-history.md): Get price history for a canonical product.
- [List Subscriptions](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/price-tracking/list-subscriptions.md): List your active price tracking subscriptions.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.trychannel3.com/price-tracking-webhooks.md)
- [Product](https://docs.trychannel3.com/product-model.md)
- [Category](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/category-model.md)
- [Brand](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/brand-model.md)
- [Website](https://docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/website-model.md)
